notes.title: Update Version 0.1.1
notes.notes:
-Changed graphics settings so the game looks more retro
-Limited manual saving to the safe zone and added autosaves when going through portals
-Added a cap to inventory size, with ways of upgrading at the workbench
-Can drop items from inventory
-Added storage containers to store you loot in at the safe zone
-Changed how doors listen to sent codes. All doors within a specific distance will open/close when you send a code now, instead of just the closest one.
-Fixed a bug where space in between letters in chest codes was too short by about half(sorry)

-Added a new resource called cloth, used for inventory upgrades and more.
-Made both left mouse button and right mouse button input morse beeps.
-Refactored items so I can now make items have more than one effect. Not using it quite be will be using it much more soon.
-Stop Joseph spawning in safe zone
